categorical_program_review.scope: Name recognition only; user-reported enrollment and remaining utility requirements are not verified.
categorical_program_review.unrecognized_meaning: An unrecognized name is unresolved, not proof of ineligibility. Confirm the specific program and its qualifiers; do not use fuzzy or substring matches.

medical_baseline.question: Does a full-time resident rely on electricity for a qualifying medical condition or home medical device?

notes: This is a screening result, not an enrollment decision.
Gross annual household income includes taxable and non-taxable income from household members.
PG&E may request proof after enrollment.
Medical Baseline is based on medical need rather than income and requires practitioner certification.
privacy: Do not provide SSN, medical records, tax returns, pay stubs, or account credentials to BillFit for this screening.

human_gates.title: Confirm the unrecognized assistance program
human_gates.reason: An unmatched program name does not establish eligibility or ineligibility.
human_gates.user_action: Confirm which listed program a household member is enrolled in. Keep Tribal/income-eligible and free-lunch qualifiers; do not provide enrollment documents or infer a similar name.

human_gates.title: Apply for CARE or FERA
human_gates.reason: BillFit only screens eligibility and does not submit personal or income information.
human_gates.user_action: Review the official requirements and personally complete the PG&E CARE/FERA application.
